business: Private fusion-energy company, an MIT spin-out, building the SPARC demonstration tokamak and high-temperature superconducting magnets in Devens, Massachusetts, with ARC, its first commercial plant, planned for Virginia in the early 2030s.

funding.status: Private. $1B additional equity financing announced 30 Jul 2026 (company release, mirrored on PR Newswire; TechCrunch, Boston Globe, Utility Dive the same day) from unnamed institutional investors described as pension funds, sovereign wealth funds and infrastructure and industrial corporate partners; total capital raised now $4B. Preceded by the $863M Series B2 announced 28 Aug 2025 (Google, NVentures, Morgan Stanley Counterpoint Global, Bill Gates and new international investors) and the $1.8B Series B of 2021. Commercial: more than $1B power purchase agreement with Eni for ARC (22 Sep 2025); 200 MW PPA with Google (June 2025); Google DeepMind AI partnership for SPARC (Oct 2025).

brief: The largest private fusion company, building the SPARC demonstration machine in Devens, Massachusetts and designing ARC, a 400 MW commercial plant in Virginia already contracted to Google and Eni.
